name: smwsprites-homing-thwomp-boss
title: Homing Thwomp Boss
description:
-Name of Sprite: Homing Thwomp
-Author: yoshicookiezeus
-Generator?: No
-Extra Bit Used?: No
-Sprite Graphics File?: Uses GFX03 in SP3 and GFX02 in SP4.
-Description: A custom Thwomp boss that follows Mario horizontally when on the ceiling, and falls when it gets close enough to him. It spawns Bob-ombs when it hits the floor, and is damaged by their explosions. It has three hit points and gets faster after each hit. See the enclosed readme for more information.
